name: 侠客行2000最新版
group_note: 侠客行I ("The Quest of Oriental Chivalry"), XiaKeXing Gaming Group 1996-1999, MudOS v22b25 lineage, ported by sdong. WASM pass fixed: (1) §7.52-class from-scratch HTTP server: adm/daemons/network/http.lpc (the classic Truilkan/Jacques Interstice httpd.c, same lineage AGENTS.md already documents for mnhf) calls socket_create()/socket_bind()/socket_close() directly with no availability guard, failing the whole daemon's compile under WASM. No other file calls into this daemon (grepped, zero external callers), so per §7.52's default, gutted every socket-touching function (setup(), write_data_retry(), store_client_info(), listen_callback(), close_connection()'s socket_close call) to no-ops rather than patching call sites individually. (2) §8.1-class check_legal_name() bug in adm/daemons/logind.lpc: byte-count length bound (2-8, meant to be 1-4 characters) plus an i%2 parity gate PLUS a destructive 'fixup' hack (name[j]+=128 on any character the (already-disabled, commented-out) is_chinese check flagged) that would have corrupted valid names under UTF8 codepoint indexing -- rewrote the length bound to character count (1-4) and removed the +=128 mutation entirely (the underlying is_chinese-based rejection was already commented out by the original author, so this only removes the leftover corrupting side effect, not any active validation). adm/simul_efun/chinese.lpc's is_chinese() was already a correct per-codepoint check. Admin seeded via securityd.lpc's actual persisted save file (data/securityd.o, a plain-text saved-mapping literal, NOT the vestigial adm/etc/wizlist.h/wizlist text files which are read nowhere in the active codebase) -- added fluffos to both wiz_status ('(admin)') and wiz_sites ('.*', unrestricted, matching the existing 'npc' bootstrap entry's pattern) since logind.lpc's get_id() calls SECURITY_D->valid_wiz_login() for any wizard-level id and rejects logins whose euid has no wiz_sites entry at all, regardless of get_status() tier -- the existing waiwai/xgslxz admin accounts are IP-locked to 192.168.0.40 specifically, which would have blocked WASM-test/127.0.0.1 logins if copied verbatim. Registration flow verified end-to-end in one continuous WASM client session: GB/BIG5 encoding select -> English id -> y/n create-confirm -> Chinese name -> password + confirm -> gift-stat accept (y) -> email (id@address format) -> gender (m/f) -> enters world with a full character sheet and working score/look commands, zero unexpected errors. Admin permission directly confirmed via 'wizlist' command output showing '目前权限：(admin)' with no site-check rejection. LPC formatter run across all 8096 .lpc files (8021 written, 24 errors on messy legacy code, 51 unchanged); reverted 1 file (d/taihu/gumu/houtang.lpc) with confirmed pre-existing (author-side, predates this pass) unterminated-string corruption in its item_desc mapping (missing closing quotes around two 'hua1'/'hua2' entries) that the formatter's tokenizer re-spaced further. No :: parent-call split hits, no case-label-with-trailing-comment candidates. All 7 map.lpc files confirmed content-identical (whitespace-only) to their pre-format blobs. Post-formatter re-verified with the same full registration flow -- clean, admin permission still (admin), no site-check rejection.
